sentences.japanese: 力士の横にいると小っちゃく見えるな。
sentences.english: You look tiny next to a sumo wrestler.

sentences.japanese: 顔色が悪いよ。すぐにベッドに横になった方がいい。
sentences.english: You look pale. You had better lie down in bed at once.

sentences.japanese: 熊が眠ったり横になるとき、その姿勢は熱を逃したいのか保ちたいのかによる。
sentences.english: When bears sleep or lie down, their postures depend on whether they want to get rid of heat or conserve it.

sentences.japanese: 京子は草の上に横になっています。
sentences.english: Kyoko is lying on the grass.

sentences.japanese: 患者は目を閉じてベッドに横たわっていた。
sentences.english: The patient was lying in the bed with his eyes closed.
